card.name: Space before a dose number
card.fires_on: The space (or slash) right before a dose or strength number such as 20 mg, 40 mg or 8 mg/mL. It appears in dosing text after words like 'as', 'or', 'exceed' or after a previous strength in a list.

modes.label: Dose limits and alternatives
modes.description: Space before a mg figure after 'exceed', 'or', 'as' or 'greater than' in dosing sentences.
modes.example: Initiate MYCAPSSA at a dosage of 40 mg daily, administered as<< >>20 mg orally twice daily. Monitor

modes.label: Strength tables
modes.description: Space or slash before the next strength in a list of concentrations or combination products.
modes.example: 1 vial Entire contents (approximately 21 mL) 125 mL 16 mg/mL 250 mL<< >>8 mg/mL 500 mL

card.writes: It seems to lower the odds of spelled-out numbers like three or six, favouring digit numbers instead.
card.plain: It fires on the blank space just before a dose number, so the next thing written is a numeral.
